# Cases for tools/check_ci_classes.py (issue #1258): the files of a change, and
# the work that it must select. The expected sets come from the rules of the
# issue, not from the output of the classifier, so a wrong line of
# .github/ci-classes.txt fails a case. `ALL` stands for every gate, and `-`
# for no label.
#
#   case <name>
#   files <path> [<path>...]       (may repeat)
#   gates <gate>,<gate>,...
#   labels <label>,... | all | -
#   legs <preset>,... | -            (optional) the presets of the native job
#   targets all | - | <target> ...  (optional) what the debug leg builds
#   names - | <target> ...         (optional) the test targets that run by name

case a document alone runs only the placement check
files docs/decisions/distribution.md README.md
gates placement
labels -
legs -
targets -

case a spec clarification runs the tables and the probe steps, not whole jobs
files spec/04-semantics.md
gates placement,tables,native-unit,probes
labels -
names BootstrapErrorKindAudit BootstrapSuspendCalls
legs debug,release
targets -

case a change of the VM core runs everything the VM reaches
files src/vm.cpp
gates placement,tables,format,native-build,native-unit,native-checks,jvm,qbe,cross,codecrafters,lsp,neovim,vscode,release-static
labels all
legs debug,release
targets all

case a change of the Dockerfile runs everything
files Dockerfile
gates ALL
labels all

case a file that no rule names runs everything
files brand_new_directory/file.txt
gates ALL
labels all

case a JVM-only change skips the QBE job
files src/backend/jvm_emitter.cpp

labels jvm
legs debug,release
targets test_jvm_emit
